Lemma
[Separating incompressible surfaces] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0203 1. ch31:31.21\group 3-manifold topology

If a closed surface separates a closed 3-manifold into two pieces and is incompressible in both, then it is incompressible in the whole manifold and the fundamental groups of both pieces inject into the whole group.
